versions.subject: rule: service binaries in suspicious folders
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|startswith: 'HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\'
    TargetObject|endswith: '\Start'
    Image|contains: 
        - '\AppData\Local\'
        - '\AppData\Roaming\'
    Details: 
        - 'DWORD (0x00000000)'  # boot
        - 'DWORD (0x00000001)'  # System
        - 'DWORD (0x00000002)'  # Automatic
        # 3 - Manual , 4 - Disabled
selection_2:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|startswith: 'HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\'
    TargetObject|endswith: '\ImagePath'
    Details|contains:
        - '\AppData\Local\'
        - '\AppData\Roaming\'
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: (EventType="SetValue" TargetObject="HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*" TargetObject="*\\Start" Image IN ("*\\AppData\\Local\\*", "*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*") Details IN ("DWORD (0x00000000)", "DWORD (0x00000001)", "DWORD (0x00000002)")) OR (EventType="SetValue" TargetObject="HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*" TargetObject="*\\ImagePath" Details IN ("*\\AppData\\Local\\*", "*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*"))
